title: The Graveyard Book — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
The story The Graveyard Book tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. The Graveyard Book is a young adult novel written by the English author Neil Gaiman, simultaneously published in the United Kingdom and in the United States in 2008. The Graveyard Book traces the story of the boy Nobody "Bod" Owens, who is adopted and reared by the supernatural occupants of a graveyard after his family is brutally murdered.

Strip The Graveyard Book of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. Later that year, Neil Gaiman stated that he has no involvement with the film. In September 2024, it was reported that the production had been halted due to a variety of factors including sexual misconduct allegations against Gaiman.
